column1: # Scheduled subway ride time from each ridership station complex to Midtown and Lower Manhattan
# Built 2026-11-17 by scripts/features_midtown.py
# Sources:
#   - MTA subway GTFS (scheduled station-to-station times
#   - Staten Island Ferry schedule (25-minute crossing): https://www.siferry.com/
#   - OpenStreetMap pedestrian network (from features_walk.py): https://download.bbbike.org/osm/bbbike/NewYork/NewYork.osm.pbf
# Columns:
#   station_complex_id: MTA station complex id (matches data/ridership/station_complexes.csv)
#   station_complex: station complex name
#   ride_minutes_to_midtown: scheduled minutes from the complex to Times Sq or Grand Central
column3: no initial wait (0 = the complex is in Midtown)

#   km_to_midtown: straight-line distance to Midtown
#   km_to_downtown: straight-line distance to Fulton St
# Notes:
#   Walking 75 m/min; 5 min average wait at the first station; transfers between platforms within 300 m cost the walk (x1.3) + 3 min. Waits at transfers are not modelled beyond that
column2: so lines with rare service look a little faster than they are.

column1: #   Ride times are scheduled weekday-style times between consecutive stations (median over trips)

column2: this is the time using existing stations; a new station would make it shorter.
